meta.title: Prompt Assistance & Fast Acceleration
meta.description: Provides prompt enhancement, next-question suggestions, and Priority acceleration (OpenAI / xAI), with profile-wide auxiliary models, reasoning effort, Fast and QA scope for each feature.

fast.label: Fast
fast.off: Fast is off. Enable Priority for this session and inheriting subagents on authorized models (OpenAI gpt/o families, xAI Grok 4 and later); provider support is required and billing follows the tier the provider actually used.
fast.on: Fast is on for this session and inheriting subagents on authorized models (OpenAI gpt/o families, xAI Grok 4 and later). The provider bills the tier it actually used. Click to turn off.
fast.error: Could not change Fast. Try again.
fast.command: Read or set this session's Fast (request-level Priority); subagents inherit their parent until explicitly overridden (on / off / status).
fast.unsupported: Fast is only available for explicitly allowed routes in a supported accelerated family (OpenAI gpt/o, or xAI Grok 4 and later).
fast.enabled: Fast enabled for this session and inheriting subagents. The provider bills the tier it actually used.
fast.disabled: Fast disabled for this session and inheriting subagents. Subsequent requests keep provider defaults.
assist.command: Session-local configuration is retired. Configure auxiliary models and QA scope in the profile-wide Prompt assist settings.
assist.retired: The retired assist configuration entry is disabled. Use Prompt assist.
